verdict.rationale: Riveter is a data-enrichment/web-scraping service (not itself an agent), so an official MCP server for AI assistants is a fair axis. Docs explicitly describe connecting via a hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.riveterhq.com/mcp as a custom connector) as well as a local Node.js MCP server option, explicitly supporting Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible assistant. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs, and no detail on tool/resource schema exposed via the server.
